name: Doubly Blocked Terminal Layers Through Eleven Are Two-Connected
statement: If $K\subsetneq A$ are ample, every concept of $D=A\setminus K$ is doubly blocked, and $|D|\le11$, then the residual graph induced by $D$ is two-connected.
proof: Connectivity and minimum degree two follow from the preceding terminal-component arguments. A cut vertex would force the unique eleven-vertex wedge of two degree-two-rooted dominoes. Coordinate labels reduce this wedge to two profiles, according as the middle domino directions coincide or differ. For each profile, a dimension-free passive-coordinate encoding imposes support order, carrier anchors and depths, cross-carrier cubes, marker reversal, and the degree-three dichotomy. Independently checked DRAT cores prove both relaxed formulas unsatisfiable, so no genuine doubly blocked interval has a cut vertex.
